body:
Found during the quick gate of PR #2594 (#2340). The PR does not touch `crates/ui/src/diag.rs`.

## What happens

`diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` (`crates/ui/src/diag.rs:124`) fails in some full parallel runs of `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`:

```
panicked at crates/ui/src/diag.rs:139:9:
the note is an INFO event: 2026-11-18T21:12:45.153099Z  WARN camcraft_ui: gpu: test adapter failed: no surface - trying the next adapter
```

The captured output has the WARN line, but not the INFO line ("headless: test adapter").

Readings on Linux, 12 cores, `--test-threads=10`, tree `v0.24.0` plus PR #2594:
- Full lib run: 1 failure in 3 runs (the quick gate step `ui suites: lib`; then two clean runs, 1170 passed).
- The test alone (`--exact`): 3 passes in 3 runs.

## Suspected cause (not confirmed)

- `diag::info` is one `tracing::info!` callsite. All UI code and all UI tests use it.
- The test installs its subscribers with `tracing::subscriber::with_default`, which is thread-local.
- `tracing` caches the interest of each callsite for the whole process. Other tests run on other threads at the same time, and a new dispatcher causes a rebuild of the cached interest.
- Thus the INFO callsite can be disabled while this test's "info" subscriber is the default on its thread. The WARN callsite stays enabled, which agrees with the output above.

## Expected

The test passes in each parallel run.

## Possible directions (not tested)

- Run the assertions in a separate process or a test binary of its own, so no other test shares the callsites.
- Call `tracing::callsite::rebuild_interest_cache()` after the subscriber is installed, and before each event.
- Serialize the test with the other tests that emit `diag` lines (a lock, as `snapshot_guard` does for the theme cells in #2373).

## Labels

I cannot set labels (no triage access). Suggested by the precedent of #2373: `bug`, `P3`, `effort:medium`, `area:ui`. Filed by an agent session for a contributor, thus `source:agent` also applies.

Done means: `diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` passes in repeated full parallel runs of `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, and the fix says which runs were measured.
